title: Evaluation of an embedded circuit
statement: Let $D_1,ots,D_k$ be a finite list of directed acyclic Boolean circuits, each with $m$ inputs, and let $s$ be a list of $m$ indices into an initial Boolean list $I$. Assume every index in $s$ is less than the length of $I$. For any $j<k$, after executing the gates obtained by embedding all the circuits using $s$, starting from $I$, the value at the index given by the length of $I$ plus the embedding offset of $D_{j+1}$ equals the output of $D_{j+1}$ on the input whose $i$th coordinate is the value of $I$ at the index specified by the $i$th entry of $s$, with out-of-range lookups interpreted as false.
hypotheses_covered: Each circuit in the list has $m$ inputs
